title: Give every commit gate a recovery that is not a bypass
text: The file-line pre-commit gate, the yoke check file-line CLI and the yoke git pre-commit help now name splitting or shortening the file as the recovery. Two other commit gates still teach git commit --no-verify: the path-claim coverage check and the worktree status invariant. Each needs a named non-bypass recovery before the git hooks record's claim that hook messages never suggest --no-verify holds for every gate.
